## Saturation adjustment inside a snapy stage (thermodynamics card) {#sec-ch14-saturation}

### Summary

After each stage of its time integrator, snapy brings condensable species back to phase equilibrium by calling
kintera's saturation adjustment at fixed density and internal energy. It then asks kintera how many cells failed
to converge, and redoes the step with a smaller time step if any did. Content from source reading only.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Phase equilibrium of @sec-ch04 at fixed density and internal energy, in place on the mass fractions.

**Data.** Density [$\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$], internal energy [$\mathrm{J\,m^{-3}}$], mass fractions [-] (updated).

**Placement.** End of every snapy stage; failure count read by snapy's redo check.

**Activation.** Always, for a moist equation of state; warm start on.

**Guarantee / limits.** Failed cells are counted, not raised.

**Evidence.** No kintera test of the call site; see the Tests layer.
:::

### Derivation

No derivation: the adjustment is derived in @sec-ch04.

### Numerical method

snapy computes the total density and the internal energy from its conserved state, forms the mass fractions, and
calls `ThermoY.forward` with `warm_start` true on the interior cells ([`snapy meshblock.cpp:829-837`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/f93b1cf12819be2d310f8aa84fb74cc627e9ac70/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L829-L837)). The call updates the mass fractions
in place ({{< code src/thermo/thermo_y.cpp ThermoYImpl::forward >}}). snapy's redo check reads
`take_saturation_adjustment_failures` ({{< code src/thermo/thermo_y.cpp ThermoYImpl::take_saturation_adjustment_failures >}},
[`snapy meshblock.cpp:1272-1275`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/f93b1cf12819be2d310f8aa84fb74cc627e9ac70/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1272-L1275)), which returns and resets the number of failed cells.

The figure is not provided: the figure module is not written yet.
